|lore=The Guidenhouser ejection seat has saved many pilots from their exploding starships. However, system malfunctions have sometimes caused spontaneous ejection.
|game_text=Deploy on opponent’s starfighter with a permanent pilot. Starfighter’s game text (except related to identity and ability of permanent pilot, and capacity) is suspended and it is forfeit +5. (Immune to Alter.)
|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Eject! Eject! (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on opponent's starfighter with a permanent pilot. Game text (except that which is related to capacity, identity, ability of permanent pilot, and permanent astromech) is suspended, and that starfighter is forfeit +5.[Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on opponent’s starfighter with a permanent pilot. Starfighter’s game text (except related to identity and ability of permanent pilot, and capacity) is suspended and it is forfeit +5. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “Game” → “Starfighter’s game”; removed “that which is”; “capacity, identity,” → “identity and”; “permanent astromech)” → “capacity)”; “suspended,” → “suspended”; “that starfighter” → “it”; “+5.[Immune” → “+5. (Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 08. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Eject! Eject!]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Eject! Eject! (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Eject! Eject!]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_8.
